_comment: Tier 1, sized to one night. Measured 2026-09-19: 163 s for a cold 200 s run with evidence, faster for later configs at the same site (the sweep is site-major, so the capture stays cached). 9 configs x 24 sites is about 8 h. pass7-configs-tier2.json holds the rest; run it next, or merge the two for a machine with more time. Every config is scored against `baseline` at the same site, and `baseline_again` is the determinism proof, so neither can be dropped.
